feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates. What it means for consumers?
entry.summary: Mark Zandi, chief economist with Moody's Analytics, talks about the Federal Reserve's expected decision to raise interest rates and the implications of that move.

entry.title: Rep. Thomas Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war
entry.summary: Rep. Thomas Massie has moved to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The Kentucky Republican alleges that Hegseth has waged the Iran war illegally, among other "high crimes and misdemeanors."

entry.title: 'Machine Gods' explores the latest developments in the world of AI
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep talks to tech journalists Casey Newton and Kevin Roose about their new show 'Machine Gods,' which is coming to NPR.

entry.title: Vanity Fair feature profiles the political development of JD Vance at Yale
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel talks with journalist Chris Whipple about his new Vanity Fair feature with revealing details about the political development of JD Vance.

entry.title: New maps reveal massive gaps in access to affordable birth control across the U.S
entry.summary: Because of a data lag, the current reality of access may be even worse.

entry.title: The Fed raises interest rates for the first time in over three years
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate Wednesday to combat stubborn inflation. That will make it more expensive to borrow money to buy a car or carry a balance on a credit card.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates Wednesday, new reports detail the damage and $30 billion price tag of the Iran war, Kennedy Center board votes to close after judge's ruling.

entry.title: Guitar duo Rodrigo y Gabriela explores the meaning of home with new album
entry.summary: The Mexican guitar duo of Rodrigo y Gabriela found an unexpected kinship with the people of Japan when they play there. A new album called "OurHome" explores what it means to feel at home.

entry.title: Why Steve Bannon sided with Sanders, not Trump, on AI
entry.summary: Where does Steve Bannon fit in the debate over regulating or slowing AI? He tells Morning Edition where he breaks with Trump and what he thinks Washington should do.

entry.title: Democrats to send volunteers to polls this November to prevent voter intimidation
entry.summary: Democrats plan to send at least 10,000 volunteer "Democracy Protectors" to the polls during the midterms to deter voter intimidation.
